title: Kyler Murray has a sore hamstring, Vikings plan to start him in Week 9 if healthy

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Kyler Murray has a sore hamstring, Vikings plan to start him in Week 9 if healthy
sources.description: Vikings quarterback Kyler Murray said he was dealing with hamstring tightness late in Sunday's loss to the Lions and his hamstring remains an issue on Monday.
